Criterion: Verify that the landing gear arrangement and servicing criteria prevents ground contact (including servicing equipment, arresting cables, runway lights, etc.) at all weapons loading configurations, engine runs, and for flat gear or flat tire, or flat gear and flat tire situations. Standard: The design provides sufficient clearance between landing gear parts, all of the air vehicle structure, other systems and the ground. Minimum clearances are maintained at all times and for all operational conditions. Method of Compliance: Verification methods include analysis and demonstration. Clearance analysis verifies ground clearance for all possible operations. Taxi and turning demonstrations validate the clearance analysis. References: JSSG-2009: A.3.4.1.1.1, A.4.4.1.1.1 Gear arrangement; A.3.4.1.1.3, A.4.4.1.1.3 Extended Clearances; A.3.4.1.1.6, A.4.4.1.1.6 Clearance with flat tire and flat strut. AFGS-87139 3.2.1.2 Arrangement; 3.2.1.3.a Clearances. 14 CFR 13.1-13.2.4, 23.1501, 23.1529, 25.1501, 25.1503-25.1533, 25.1529, 25.1541, 25.1543, 25.1557, 25.1563

Standard: For all operational and servicing conditions (e.g., multivariate landing, taxi, takeoff, ski jumps, all stores loading configurations, engine runs, flat gear with flat tire, and deflated strut situations), the landing gear system maintains ground clearance between any part of the air vehicle and air vehicle components and the ground (e.g., service equipment, air vehicle arrestment systems, runway lights, catapult shuttle, and deck obstructions). Clearance will also be maintained between landing gear components, stores, and any part of the air vehicle. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Analysis.
(1) Clearance analysis verifies the landing gear system maintains ground clearance for all operational conditions and clearance to stores and parts of the air vehicle as specified in MIL- STD-1289, Store to Aircraft Clearance, Minimum Ground Clearance, and Landing Gear Clearance paragraphs. Demonstration.
  (1) Conduct taxi and turning demonstrations to verify analysis. Prior to entering operational test/operations, verify the standard by the above and following method(s): Demonstration.
  (2) Conduct flight demonstration to verify landing gear system maintains ground clearance during normal takeoff and landing operations.
